Maya (Docs): FYI PR 4321 is blocking the console/observability snippets — the trace hook Node example errors in the preview with `TypeError: unknown param 'traceKey'`
Sam (Eng-Obs): looking now, we renamed `traceKey` -> `trace_id` in runtime last week. docs PR must have missed a couple of snippets.
TJ (SDK): my bad, I shipped a compatibility shim but didn't update the example variants for python/rust/node. can patch.
Maya (Docs): can you patch Node + embed snippet? it's preventing the docs deploy (preview failing).
TJ (SDK): will open a tiny PR to fix the snippets and leave a comment in the main PR. ETA ~30m.
Gio (Platform): heads-up: changing the snippet param is fine as long as the compat shim stays. i'll keep an eye on the preview cluster for any regressions.
Eli (QA): once patched, can someone run the playground smoke test and paste the curl + response? e.g. `curl -s -X POST https://docs-preview.redwood.ai/playground -d '{"example":"trace"}'`
deploy-bot: PR 4321 status: preview-checks failed (render error)
TJ (SDK): opened PR 4323 with snippet updates for node/python/rust, plus a one-line comment about the fallback. small code sample in PR: ```js
// new param name uses trace_id, fallback kept for older runtimes
traceHook({ trace_id: process.env.TRACE_ID })
```
Maya (Docs): thanks. i also noticed the sidebar link to /console/observability/old-tracehook still exists (from a legacy redirect). can someone sweep redirects?
Sam (Eng-Obs): creating redirect PR and adding a short migration note: `traceKey -> trace_id` and example diff for quick copy/paste.
Eli (QA): smoke run after PR 4323 merged: `HTTP 200` and inspector shows `{"trace_id":"abc123"}` in the payload. no errors.
Maya (Docs): merging docs PRs after +1 from @Gio and @Eli. leaving a follow-up to add a tiny migration snippet in the console obsv guide. thanks all :tada:
